author: Sup3r_Chicken
body: That simply wasn't the case. I was kicked on 7/12/15 on a nebula game for "aiding the opponent." I was building a bridge to the opponents monument, and out of the blue, was kicked. No warning, no nothing. don't remember exact username, but it was something like cyanide.

title: Kicked for aiding the opposing team

replies.author: SirCyanide
replies.body: You Were bridging from your monument to theirs when there was already a bridge leading to the other side. I messaged you a couple of times asking you to stop in chat. I got no respond and you were clearly giving your team a unfair disadvantage.

replies.author: Porkyyy
replies.body:
Hello,

I have checked the logs, and saw that SirCyanide did give you a private message, insinuating that you should stop. Either way, this is just a kick. You shouldn't worry too much about it.
I also talked to SirCyanide on TeamSpeak and he explained the situation to me. If you would like to talk to me on TeamSpeak about it, I'll be happy to address your concern, but I wouldn't worry too much about this infraction as it is not too much of a big deal.

Regards,
MLGPorky, Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
